concepts.def: Brooks, Wimsatt 1930s-50s; intentional fallacy; close reading without biography; text as autonomous artefact.
Lukacs, Eagleton; literature reflects class struggle; base-superstructure; ideology; Marxism and Literary Criticism 1976.
Freud's Oedipus complex; Lacan's mirror stage and symbolic order; reads text as unconscious desire.
Showalter Literature of Their Own 1977; Gilbert and Gubar Madwoman in Attic 1979; gynocriticism, female tradition.
Saussure's signifier/signified; Derrida's deconstruction 1967; meaning unstable; play of differences.
Iser, Jauss 1970s; meaning produced in reading not text alone; horizon of expectations, implied reader.
